entries.headline: Pentagon preparations and increased US activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that the Pentagon had directed US Central Command to prepare for possible large-scale combat with Iran as US military activity increased over the continental United States.

entries.headline: War Watch shares TWZ report on B-1B shelter concerns
entries.summary: War Watch shared a The War Zone report saying a B-1B’s sudden departure from a United Kingdom airbase highlighted limited investment in aircraft shelters, crediting reagan0965 for the item.

entries.headline: Boeing C-40B SAM233 reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing C-40B registration 01-0041 using callsign SAM233 and hex AE11F6, attributing the sighting to reagan0965 and the photograph to Westley_SJU via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report on carrier group valor award
entries.summary: War Watch shared a Stars and Stripes report that the Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group received the US military’s highest unit-level award for valor in battle, crediting reagan0965 for the item.

entries.headline: Six transports, command aircraft and surveillance flight reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States, along with a US surveillance aircraft heading toward Scotland from Bangor.

entries.headline: US transports, command aircraft and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with 20 coded military radio broadcasts heard during the day and the most recent two hours earlier.

entries.headline: Command aircraft, heavy transports and 20 broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported nuclear command aircraft and multiple heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States, alongside 20 coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: Gulfstream V FAZE21 reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported Gulfstream V registration 19-1587 using callsign FAZE21 and hex AE17CD, attributing the sighting to reagan0965 and the photograph to Westleigh Bushell via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Four transports, command aircraft and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with 20 coded radio broadcasts heard during the day and none during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Four coded broadcasts and six specialist aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the preceding hour and six specialised military aircraft airborne over the United States, including a nuclear command aircraft and a surveillance aircraft.

entries.headline: USAF MC-130J reported flying circuits near King’s Lynn
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force MC-130J-30 Commando II registration 13-5786 flying circuits east of King’s Lynn after departing RAF Mildenhall, attributing the sighting to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: US transports and elevated Baltic activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport and surveillance aircraft over the continental United States, Baltic-region air activity at four times its stated normal level, and one coded radio broadcast. The visible post is truncated after that point.
